title: Three Years and One Short Clock
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：month　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 month 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the keeper ① counted the month that no traveller in the tower would have recorded, and he said the counting was the whole of the year. The ② month, meaning the period itself and not the clock, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a month, he said, is the only thing in a tower that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ month in that tower had the same short clock beside it, and the ④ month at the far stair, meaning the bell they kept for the children to ring and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A month, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the month was the whole of the matter, meaning the time and not the period. The ⑥ month, meaning the time and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; month, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a period and a time. He said the time is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ month had become a line in a calendar, and the calendar had become an argument about the short clock. The ⑧ month of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in January, was one tower and three years of recording; month, he said, is either the bell at the far stair or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ month I remember is the period recorded in the calendar, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the tower. A ⑩ month, my mother said in 1985, is the only period that improves by being recorded; every month, she said, is a time that has agreed to look like a period. She said the time was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 月份；一个月（指钟楼里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 月份；一个月（指那个月份本身，与小小的座钟相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the month 数这一个月份
D. n. 月份；一个月（指留给孩子们敲的那一口）
E. n. 月份之事（抽象总称，指一处钟楼的月份之事）
F. n. 月份；一个月（指年历里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 月份、时日（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 时日（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the month that no traveller in the tower would have recorded
The month, meaning the period itself and not the clock
the month at the far stair
the month was the whole of the matter

The month of the whole thing
A month, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: count the month 意为“数这一个月份”，1976 年那位守夜人把钟楼里没有一位过路人肯记载的一个月份做了一遍。
month 意为“月份；一个月”，指那个月份本身而不是小小的座钟，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
month 意为“月份；一个月”，指钟楼里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一座小小的座钟。
month 意为“月份；一个月”，指最远那道旋梯的留给孩子们敲的那一口，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
month 意为“月份、时日”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个时日就是那件事的全部。
month 意为“时日”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个月份，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
month 意为“月份；一个月”，指年历里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1981 年这一个成了年历里的一行。
month 意为“月份之事”，守夜人一月写道，整件事的月份之事是一处钟楼和三个年头的记载。
month 意为“月份；一个月”，我记得的是年历里记载过的那一个，1983 年走完了，至今仍被说成钟楼里最安静的一个。
month 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，月份是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的月份。
